svg.aria-label: Animated image patches become tokens and write into two independent TTT memories. Reference enters left in purple; completed execution enters right in pink.
svg.title: Stable intent. Updated progress.
svg.desc: Real recorded images; tokens, tint, motion and matrices are teaching illustrations, not extracted activations or measured capacity. Reference stays fixed during rollout. Only completed interactions write progress. Action-side Q reads both memories serially.

g.text: Two fast states. Not a video cache.
Real source images. Tokens, matrix tint and animation timing are explanatory, not measured activations.
Reference and execution belong to the same selected case. Reference fast weights stay protected.
